title: Relationship between body composition and PBRM1 mutations in clear cell renal cell carcinoma: a propensity score matching analysis.
one_liner_zh: 该研究分析肾透明细胞癌患者身体成分与PBRM1基因突变的关系，仅涉及临床影像和统计匹配，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to examine the relationship between body muscle and adipose tissue composition in clear cell renal cell carcinoma patients with PBRM1 gene mutation. METHODS: Cancer Genome Atlas Kidney clear cell renal cell carcinoma and Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium clear cell renal cell carcinoma collections were retrieved from the Cancer Imaging Archive. A total of 291 clear cell renal cell carcinoma patients were included in the study retrospectively. Patients' characteristics were obtained from Cancer Imaging Archive. Body composition was assessed with abdominal computed tomography using the automated artificial intelligence software (AID-U, iAID Inc., Seoul, Korea). Body composition parameters of the patients were calculated. To investigate the net effect of body composition, the propensity score matching procedure was applied over age, gender, and T-stage parameters. RESULTS:  Of the patients, 184 were males and 107 were females. Mutations in the PBRM1 gene were detected in 77 of the patients. While there was no difference in adipose tissue areas between the PBRM1 mutation group and those without PBRM1 mutation, statistically significant differences were found in normal attenuated muscle area parameters. CONCLUSION:  This study shows that there was no difference between adipose tissue areas in patients with PBMR1 mutation, but normal attenuated muscle area was found to be higher in PBRM1 patients.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨携带PBRM1基因突变的透明细胞肾细胞癌患者体内肌肉与脂肪组织构成之间的关系。方法：从癌症影像档案库中检索了癌症基因组图谱肾透明细胞癌和临床蛋白质组学肿瘤分析联盟透明细胞肾细胞癌数据集。本研究回顾性纳入了共291例透明细胞肾细胞癌患者。患者特征数据来源于癌症影像档案库。使用自动化人工智能软件（AID-U，iAID公司，首尔，韩国）通过腹部计算机断层扫描评估身体组成。计算了患者的身体组成参数。为研究身体组成的净效应，对年龄、性别和T分期参数应用了倾向评分匹配程序。结果：患者中，184例为男性，107例为女性。在77例患者中检测到PBRM1基因突变。虽然PBRM1突变组与无PBRM1突变组之间在脂肪组织面积上无差异，但在正常衰减肌肉面积参数上发现了统计学显著差异。结论：本研究表明，携带PBRM1突变的患者在脂肪组织面积上无差异，但PBRM1患者的正常衰减肌肉面积较高。
